claude_proposed_widenings.name: reduce_damage_taken
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core mechanic is a reaction that subtracts a rolled amount plus an ability modifier from one incoming weapon hit's damage. That is neither resistance, immunity, temporary hit points, nor a roll modifier, so any current encoding would misstate the rule.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your Dexterity modifier
